annotations.title: Search flights for a small party

description: Searches live public fares for 1 to 9 travellers and returns options with per-person prices, carriers and stops, cheapest first, each with an offer_id valid for 30 minutes. Results come in pages: pass next_cursor back as cursor, with the same route and dates, for more.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of this search. Omit for the first page.

destination.description: Arrival airport, IATA code, e.g. BCN.

origin.description: Departure airport, IATA code, e.g. VIE.

passengers.description: How many people are travelling, 1 to 9. Defaults to 1.

return_date.description: Return date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for one way.

name: egf_search_flights

currency.description: ISO 4217 code every price is in.

offer_id.description: Identifies this fare when emailing it as an offer. Valid for this search only.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page. Absent on the last page.

return_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Absent for one way.

total.description: Fares the search found, across all pages.

title: Search flights for a small party
